description: ARV-125b: what the SigNoz rules and dashboards in Charts/platform/files/monitoring may read. Checked by MonitoringRulesTests (Ariva.UnitTests, against the instruments Ariva registers) and by checks.mjs (against every render). A change here is reviewed: a label key must name a bounded set of configuration values or constants, never a person, a credential or a value from a request; an external metric is allowed only where Ariva cannot measure, and is read within the release's namespaces (every Ariva metric within the release's deployment.environment).

externalMetrics.source: The site collector's kubelet stats receiver (SigNoz k8s-infra): free bytes of each pod volume. Ariva cannot see the volume of its database pod.
The site collector's kubelet stats receiver (SigNoz k8s-infra): size of each pod volume.

cert-manager's own metric, scraped by the site collector's Prometheus receiver; its namespace label is namespace, or exported_namespace when the scrape adds a namespace label of its own. The ingress certificate is in no Ariva pod (CWE-269: no pod mounts its key for this).
